smoke: Throwaway headless Chromium (Playwright 1.64.1, @axe-core/playwright 4.14.0) against vite preview with /api stubbed by page.route (session linked, antiforgery, one disputable transaction, POST /v1/disputes 503 core-banking-unavailable then 409 already-disputed). At 320, 767, 768 and 1280px, on raise, raise with Wrong amount (difference shown), review, review after 503 and review after the 409 refusal: axe wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa, wcag22aa gave 0 violations on all 20 pages; document scrollWidth equalled clientWidth (no horizontal scroll) on all; no console errors; Tab walk on raise: reason radio, note, Continue, Cancel; on review: Change your dispute, Submit dispute, Cancel, each with a visible focus style (below 768px the header links follow). Heights: Continue 48, Submit dispute 48, Try again 48, Cancel 48 (both screens), Change your dispute 44, Copy 44 at every width; every interactive element is at least 44px except the six Radix reason radio buttons, 24px, which predate this story. The skip link is sr-only until focused. Script, preview server and dist deleted. Fix round 2: throwaway headless Chromium (Playwright from e2e/node_modules) against vite preview of the built dist, /api stubbed by page.route (session linked, antiforgery, one transaction), review screen with a wrapping note, root font size set to 100%, 150% and 200% by a style tag, axe wcag2a/2aa/21a/21aa/22aa 0 violations at every size. Review dl columns (label / value px): 320px: 101.6/136.4 at 100%, 88.8/109.2 at 150%, 102.9/122.4 at 200%; 360px: 117.6/160.4, 104.8/133.2, 102.9/122.4; 1280px at 100%: 144 (9rem) / 302. Before the fix the value column was 22px and 0px. Residual document scroll width, outside the dl and not changed: 320px 150% 339, 320px 200% 452, 360px 200% 452 (the signed-in header: its sign-out button and the navigation); 320px 200% also has the 2rem hero amount (253px, not wrapping) making the card 323px wide in a 256px column.

Theme tokens through Tailwind v4 theme variables (form surface, quiet block)

Button asChild around the router Link; top border for the hairline
CSS grid label column; named section as a region landmark
Accessible name from content with the visible label inside it (Label in Name); 44px target
Static shadcn Alert; role alert kept for errors only

test_results.covers: ui-tokens-icons (r3-fixed patch, docs and e2e excluded) plus ui-notices-states (r1 patch) plus ui-raise-review plus its fix rounds 1 and 2, all uncommitted. Vitest: 740 tests, 0 failures, run once with --maxWorkers=3 because other lanes held the machine (load average about 8). tsc, eslint, prettier and vite build passed.

assumptions: The Change link's sr-only suffix is 'Change your dispute' (space outside the span), not the spec's ' your dispute': dom-accessibility-api joins 'Change' and ' your dispute' as 'Changeyour dispute'. The visible text and the browser's accessible name are the same.

frontend/src/lib/utils.ts is outside the spec's Touches: 'heading' is removed from the tailwind-merge font-size list. The theme has a size and a colour both named heading; Tailwind builds text-heading as the colour only, so cn('text-label text-muted-foreground', 'text-label font-strong text-heading') dropped text-label and kept the muted colour, which broke criterion 3. alert-dialog's cn('text-heading font-strong') is unchanged in output. One unit test added. The lows batch may rename the size or the colour token.

The Card and Account dl row is a small NumberRow in ReviewScreen.tsx that repeats MaskedNumber's masking (first six, two dots, last four) and its screen-reader form (printed form aria-hidden, sr-only 'card ending N' / 'account ending N'); fix round 1 restored that form. MaskedNumber stays for the list and the raise form. A third use would justify one shared helper.
Change sits top right with items-start (HANDOFF 'top right'); the mockup uses align-items flex-end. At 320px the value column is narrow beside the 9rem label column, as the spec requires.

The six reason radio buttons (Radix, 24px) are below 44px; they are unchanged and the reason cards are out of scope. QA's 44px check will report them unless the lows batch makes the whole card the hit area.
The existing aria-disabled:opacity-70 on Change, Cancel and Button is kept (Notes: a low for lows.md).
The base patches are uncommitted in the worktree (the guard refuses builder commits); diff_hash is against 2f897c3 and covers both bases plus this story. TestResults/ is gitignored.

Fix round 1: the existing test 'gives an account transaction an Account row after Date' asserted the printed '•••• 4821' text node was the dd (tagName DD); the number now sits in an aria-hidden span inside the dd, so it asserts closest('dd') instead. The row, label and value assertions are unchanged.

Fix round 1 is verified by Vitest with the axe check already in 'reads the draft back' (still 0 violations), not by a new headless Playwright pass; the change is two spans inside the same dd. Breaks 1 to 3 (RaiseScreen, TransactionSummary) were re-checked for applicability only: their files are untouched by this round. Breaks 0 and 4 to 7 were re-run on the final tree and fail.

Fix round 2: the label column is `minmax(0,min(var(--label-col),40%))` with a new theme token --label-col: 9rem (beside --amount-col) and wrap-anywhere on the dt, so 9rem holds where it fits (1280px: 144px) and the value column keeps at least 60% minus the gap. The minmax(0, ...) wrapper is needed: a bare min(9rem,40%) track counted as 9rem in the container min-content and widened the card. Criterion 5 now reads 9rem capped at 40% (WCAG 1.4.4 and 1.4.10 win, as the fix list says).

Residual, not fixed (outside the fix list, named for the supervisor): at 200% text size (root 32px) the header (Header.tsx, a base patch) overflows horizontally at 320px and 360px (scroll width 452), and at 320px the 2rem "You are disputing" amount is 253px wide and widens the review card by 35px. Neither is in the review dl. A fix is a header wrap and min-w-0 on the card.

Fix round 2: breaks 0 to 8 were all applied to the tree and the named Vitest test failed each time (break 4, the md-only grid, was rewritten for the new class; break 8 is the new fixed 9rem column); the tree was restored and its diff hash matches the full run.
